judgment_calls.decision: Trigger is (clinical_finding Pruritic rash); 'localised' not expressed.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Localized eruption of skin (loses 'itchy'); an or of both (would fire for non-itchy localised rashes).

judgment_calls.decision: No-branch diagnoses (psoriasis, pityriasis rosea, tinea corporis/pedis) do not require an explicit (no Papule of skin); site of rash (head/face/trunk/limbs vs feet) carried by the findings' own sites.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Add (no Papule of skin) to each No-branch rule; that would stop them firing unless the health worker marks 'No'.

judgment_calls.decision: Insect bites likely = itchy rash + skin papules; blistering/darkening optional ('may have'); 'usually occurs in crops' not encoded.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require blister or darkening as well (narrower than the page's question).

judgment_calls.decision: Both use the same Papule of skin finding, as the page uses 'red bumps' in both; scabies additionally needs severe itching and burrows at a listed site.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Separate qualified papule findings (no SNOMED basis for 'small').

judgment_calls.decision: 'Typically followed within 2 weeks' not encoded: the language cannot compare the onsets of two findings.
judgment_calls.alternatives: An onset bound on the oval lesions relative to now (not what the page says).

judgment_calls.decision: Annular raised skin lesion OR annular scaly skin; 'slow-growing' and 'clear in centre' not encoded.
